bio: Judson LaMoure (1839-1918), North Dakota state senator; LaMoure County, ND, is named for him. The 1919 book says the ND LaMoures descend from James (b. 1731); exact line not traced.
sources: A. J. Lamoureux, André Lamoureux, the Huguenot Emigrant, and Family (The Lamoureux Record no. 1, 1919): https://archive.org/details/andrlamoureuxh00lamouoft
